A1.label: Identifier systems
A1.description: Globally unique identifiers; namespace, issuer, object scope and examples.

A2.label: Resolution
A2.description: Resolution of explicitly selected PID examples; dated observation, not a persistence guarantee.

A3.label: Version identity
A3.description: Version-specific identifiers, version relations, immutable releases and tombstones.

A4.label: Persistence
A4.description: Published preservation, withdrawal, succession and persistence commitments.

A5.label: Collection identifiers
A5.description: Collection-level identifiers distinct from item, repository and participant identifiers.

A6.label: Citation
A6.description: Explicit dataset/release citation examples and machine-readable citation exports.

B1.label: Operations and maintenance
B1.description: Published maintenance, update, release and operational practices.

B2.label: Contacts
B2.description: Role-based public support and operational contact routes; avoid personal contact extraction.

B3.label: Support
B3.description: Documented funding, sustaining support and organizational responsibilities, dated and scoped.

B4.label: Policies
B4.description: Resource-specific governance, submission, preservation and operational policies.

B5.label: RRID
B5.description: Exact resource identity in an authoritative RRID record; parent/component distinctions.

B6.label: FAIRsharing
B6.description: Exact resource identity and record type in FAIRsharing; distinguish listed standards.

B7.label: NLM Dataset Catalog
B7.description: Dataset-level coverage or repository source inclusion; not a generic repository certification.

C1.label: Schemas and formats
C1.description: Machine-readable schemas, formats, profile names and exact versions.

C2.label: Dictionaries
C2.description: Definitions, units, datatypes and permitted values for documented fields.

C3.label: Provenance
C3.description: Lineage, attribution, transformations and source/release provenance.

C4.label: Terminologies and CDEs
C4.description: Terminology and Common Data Element identifiers, versions, bindings and local extensions.

C5.label: Mappings and ambiguity
C5.description: Crosswalks, mapping versions, direction, loss, ambiguity and validation scope.

D1.label: Data access and reuse
D1.description: Data access conditions, licenses, attribution, consent/use restrictions and version/scope.

D2.label: Model access and reuse
D2.description: Model weights, model outputs and training/use restrictions; separate from data license.

D3.label: Code access and reuse
D3.description: Code availability, version, software license and reuse conditions; separate from data/model terms.

D4.label: Interfaces
D4.description: Documented APIs, download/deposit paths, authentication, versions and rate limits.

D_scope: Access and reuse terms for data, models, and code, plus documented interfaces; user text ended here.
